summary: Iter 575 — Batch test: RMS Onboarding Wizard (rooms/guardrails/compset/data-source/mode/go-live/copilot generate+approve), Plan Locks + Upsell Modal (aldgate-flats set to 'rms' plan then restored to 'full'), Stripe pay-by-link on Booking Timeline folio. Backend: 23/23 pytest PASSED. Frontend: sidebar renders 17 locked items on rms plan (expected ~19), upsell modal opens with 4 plan rows and closes cleanly, wizard walks all 6 tabs and Go-Live reports %100 (7/7 checks), generate produced 12 recs (11 auto-applied after approve), paylink generated a REAL checkout.stripe.com URL and copy toast fired. Property 'default' plan restored to 'full', aldgate-flats restored to 'full'.

minor.issue: Response is MISSING the 'plans' map key (route conflict — older handler in another module wins). p0_pack.py builder returns {tenants, plans} but the endpoint returns only {tenants,total}. Not fatal because /plan setter still uses the new PLAN_MODULES map; but the plan-picker UI that reads d.plans may render empty. Confirmed same class of conflict already noted in iter574.

ui_bugs.issue: navigator.clipboard.writeText() throws NotAllowedError in headless / permissionless contexts and the promise rejection is UNCAUGHT — CRA dev overlay pops with 'Uncaught runtime errors: Failed to execute writeText on Clipboard'. Toast 'Kopyalandı' is still shown so user thinks it copied. Wrap in try/catch and fall back to execCommand or show a proper error toast.
Main agent context said '19 locked items on rms plan'; observed 17 (only Reservations section expanded). Non-blocking but worth double-checking planGate coverage.

action_items: MINOR (main agent): In BookingTimeline.js copyPayLink handler, wrap navigator.clipboard.writeText in try/catch (async) and show an error toast on rejection instead of leaking an unhandled promise error to the dev overlay.
MINOR (main agent): Resolve the /api/super-admin/tenants route-conflict so the PLAN_MODULES map is returned to the client (see iter574 minor#2 — same root cause).

OPTIONAL: In rms_onboarding save_compset() the caller-side dedup only checks against DB, not against payload duplicates in the SAME request. e.g. names=['A','A'] inserts 'A' once because we filter existing after each insert — but not while iterating the payload list. Passed our test by coincidence; recommend also deduping the payload list before insert (see test_06 payload contained duplicate names but 'added' was still >=1).
critical_code_review_comments: POSITIVE: rms_onboarding.py is compact (215 lines), consistent {_id:0} projections, no ObjectId leaks, all routes async, guardrails validation + mode/data-source enum validation return 400/422 correctly.
POSITIVE: /rms/setup/{pid}/mode syncs pricing_autopilot collection atomically — good separation of intent (mode) vs execution flag (auto_apply).
POSITIVE: golive endpoint returns computed score 0-100 with granular checks list — UI-friendly.
POSITIVE: /rms/copilot/generate applies rate_overrides only in autopilot mode; copilot goes to pending queue. Correct.

CONCERN: /rms/copilot/queue/{pid}/decide upserts rate_override with room_type_id='' (property-wide). If per-room-type overrides exist for the same date, they may be shadowed silently. Consider matching the wizard's per-room-type offsets on approve.
CONCERN: PlanUpsellModal shows all 4 plans always; on 'rms' plan the current row was correctly marked 'MEVCUT'. Verified.
CONCERN (medium): copyPayLink in BookingTimeline.js triggers uncaught NotAllowedError from Clipboard API. Non-secure contexts and headless browsers will always fail. Wrap in try/catch.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (email button not verified cleanly due to dev-overlay from clipboard rejection)

Default plan RESTORED to full.

Paylink generation returns real Stripe checkout URLs (test key configured). One frontend defect worth fixing: paylink-copy-btn's clipboard.writeText is not wrapped in try/catch → CRA runtime error overlay appears in headless.
